policy: Hold uncertain maximum ages; retain numerical research records, exclude from approved play and rankings. Keyword matches alone are not exclusions. Empirical ring counts and known-age captive records are eligible.

decisions.reason: The current maximum needs empirical record verification: source notes describe an estimated, projected, anecdotal, or uncertain-age maximum. No replacement value is inferred.
